rules.title: Bank overlay / OTP grabber
rules.reason: Known signature of a module that draws overlays over banking apps or steals one-time passwords.

rules.title: Partition destroyer
rules.reason: Known signature of a module that wipes or corrupts system partitions.

rules.title: Known spyware module
rules.reason: Known signature of a module that collects device and account data.

rules.title: Wallet or seed-phrase stealer
rules.reason: Strings associated with stealing crypto wallets or recovery phrases.

rules.title: Likely AI-generated module
rules.reason: Common marker of hastily generated modules that are known to bootloop devices.

rules.title: Known VFS conflict
rules.reason: This module is known to conflict with overlay/VFS based module mounting.

rules.title: Experimental SuSFS clone
rules.reason: Early SuSFS re-implementation that is known to break other modules.
